threat_event: Attacker exploits a known vulnerability in a legacy fielded device (VM-500 end-of-support OS or IV-300 first-generation wireless module) to change alarm limits or pump settings at multiple hospitals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 41,000 VM-500 units on an OS that reaches end of support 2027-06; 62,000 IV-300 pumps on first-generation modules with per-hospital pre-shared keys and TLS 1.0; KEV-listed components in legacy firmware
regulatory_driver: N31-33-R05 (524B(b)(2)(B) for IV-300 v2); FDA postmarket guidance (2016); 21 CFR 806.10; SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: PSIRT monitoring with SBOM matching; ISAO membership; customer security guides with compensating network controls; bedside alarms independent of the network
treatment_plan: Customer advisory with compensating controls; accelerate the IV-300 second-generation module swap and VM-500 replacement program; publish end-of-support dates; isolate legacy devices at the ingestion edge (POAM-023)
key_risk_indicator: Legacy units in the field; KEV matches in legacy SBOMs; module swap rate

threat_event: Malicious or unapproved code enters a firmware build and is signed and distributed to fielded devices

existing_controls: Code review with branch protection; HSM signing with two approvers; artifact re-verification; SBOM per build
treatment_plan: Signed provenance for firmware builds (POAM-004); enforce PLM approval before promotion for all lines (POAM-010); reproducible builds (SA-10(1), 2027-06-30)
key_risk_indicator: Releases without provenance; promotion gate exceptions

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts enterprise IT, ERP, and plant systems at more than one site
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large estate (16,000 endpoints, 3 plants); MN-1 flat network (R-020)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06; SYS-07; SYS-09; BP-07 to BP-10
regulatory_driver: SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; state breach laws
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on 97% of endpoints; PAM; immutable backups; annual DR tests; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Segment MN-1 (POAM-006); EDR on MN-1 OT-compatible hosts; annual enterprise ransomware exercise including plants
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; mean time to contain; DR test results

threat_event: RCM platform outage or failed recovery delays urgent arrhythmia notifications beyond the 4-hour MTD
